entries.name: 北极原住民哲学
entries.recognitionCue: Aurora and starry blue-green polar night, ice bay, snow mountains and whale/seals; fur-clad people sharing oral teaching around fire with distinctive faces and gestures; stone cairn, snow shelters, reindeer and polar bears at their existing scales, foreground carvings and sleds. Paint the warm human faces finely against the cold atmosphere, retain nature/community relationship, do not substitute a generic European gathering.

entries.name: 古埃及哲学
entries.recognitionCue: Nile valley under luminous dark sky, pyramids, tall obelisk, Egyptian columns and reliefs, boats; linen-clad scribes reading and writing papyrus on foreground terrace and sky-observation group at right with existing instruments. Preserve temple/pyramid silhouettes and fine papyrus marks; differentiate each face and purposeful hand activity, reduce shiny skin/CGI stone. The environment and scribal inquiry should remain the scene's subject.

entries.name: 美索不达米亚哲学
entries.recognitionCue: Huge left ziggurat with blue patterned shrine, river and canal city with distant stepped temples; evening/star-filled sky with faint constellation lines; foreground people writing and comparing clay tablets, small bronze observation instruments, central conversation, right observer. Keep tablets clearly clay with impressed small wedge-like patterns, distinctive robes and headbands, full instruments, architectural stairs and original river perspective.
